name: Freelance deliverable
summary: A digital work product, delivered hand-to-hand with cryptographic proof — no platform fee.
description: A client commissions a digital deliverable — a design file, a production cut, a dataset, an access credential — from an independent professional. The virtual hand-off travels an encrypted channel between the two wallets, and the artifact's fingerprint lands on-chain as completion evidence. Both parties are bonded, so the client's payment and the freelancer's delivery secure each other; the freelancer's catalogue can price fixed or by the hour. No marketplace sits in the middle.
